# XQCar — Langkawi Car Rental

> Family-owned car rental in Langkawi, Malaysia since 2015. Book online from RM 70/day with free delivery to Langkawi International Airport (LGK) Door 3, Kuah Ferry Jetty, or your hotel.

Canonical origin: https://car.xqholidays.com.my (locales: /en, /ms, /zh)

## Book & fleet

- [Home — car rental Langkawi](https://car.xqholidays.com.my/en): Search dates, browse fleet, book in ~90 seconds
- [About XQ Car](https://car.xqholidays.com.my/en/about): Licensed operator since 2015, owned fleet, OKU-friendly vehicles, island-wide delivery
